projects.title: AMC Repo Clearing Limited
projects.description: Built a full-stack fintech platform for AMC Repo Clearing Limited (ARCL), a SEBI-recognized clearing institution, enabling secure tri-party repo transactions, member onboarding, and collateral management with role-based access and regulatory compliance.
projects.longDescription: Developed a full-stack enterprise-grade web platform for AMC Repo Clearing Limited (ARCL), a SEBI-recognized financial infrastructure institution. The platform facilitates tri-party repo operations, member onboarding, collateral management, and transaction workflows while ensuring compliance with RBI and SEBI regulatory frameworks. Provides a structured interface for participants, clearing members, and financial entities to interact seamlessly.
highlights: Engineered secure tri-party repo transaction workflows with role-based access control for participants, clearing members, and financial entities.
Implemented member onboarding and collateral management modules compliant with SEBI and RBI regulatory frameworks.
Built scalable enterprise-grade architecture ensuring high availability and data integrity for financial operations.

projects.title: Govern AI
projects.description: Architected a full-stack Data Mapping module with LLM-assisted PIID tracking and an AI compliance engine (Groq API, Llama 3) for automated security audits and gap analysis.
projects.longDescription: Architected a full-stack Data Mapping module for Govern AI with LLM-assisted PIID tracking, interactive process maps, and an AI compliance engine using Groq API (Llama 3, Mixtral). Automated security audits against GDPR, DPDP 2025, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF 2.0. Designed an intelligent caching system with deterministic fallbacks, enforcing structured JSON outputs and delivering clause-specific remediation recommendations with automatic cache invalidation on data mutations.
highlights: Architected a full-stack Data Mapping module with LLM-assisted PIID tracking and an AI compliance engine (Groq, Llama 3, Mixtral) automating security audits against GDPR, DPDP 2025, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF 2.0.

Designed an intelligent caching system with deterministic fallbacks, enforcing structured JSON outputs and delivering clause-specific remediation recommendations with automatic cache invalidation on data mutations.
Developed a unified compliance dashboard providing real-time visibility into privacy posture and audit-ready reporting.

projects.title: EasyConnect
projects.description: Built a microservices-inspired B2B marketplace platform with 6 distinct user roles, an AI matchmaking engine, Groq LLM integration, and real-time Deal Rooms via Socket.IO.
projects.longDescription: Built a microservices-inspired B2B marketplace supporting 6 distinct user roles with multi-step KYC onboarding, subscription-based payments, and real-time Deal Rooms via Socket.IO for secure document sharing. Engineered an AI matchmaking engine using sentence-transformer embeddings and cosine similarity, integrated Groq LLM for automated seller summaries, and implemented full-text faceted search via Elasticsearch with Docker Compose orchestration.
highlights: Built a microservices-inspired B2B marketplace supporting 6 distinct user roles with multi-step KYC onboarding, subscription-based payments, and real-time Deal Rooms via Socket.IO for secure document sharing.
Engineered an AI matchmaking engine using sentence-transformer embeddings and cosine similarity, and integrated Groq LLM for automated seller summaries.
Implemented full-text faceted search via Elasticsearch with Docker Compose orchestration.

projects.title: Digivote
projects.description: A full-stack voting solution with React, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, OTP-based login, multilingual support, and role-based dashboards for User, Admin, and Super-admin.
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive e-voting platform from scratch using modern web technologies. Implemented secure user authentication, real-time event management, and cron-based automation. The admin dashboard provides analytics, event management capabilities, and Excel report exports.
highlights: Engineered a secure, event-driven e-voting system using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js, enabling transparent and tamper-proof digital elections.
Built role-based dashboards (SuperAdmin, Admin, Voter) with OTP-based authentication, multilingual (English/Hindi) support, and accessibility features.
Automated event workflows with cron jobs, real-time result tracking, and formatted Excel exports for votes and outcomes.

projects.title: Konsensus
projects.description: A collaborative boardroom management application with real-time updates, drag-and-drop functionality, and meeting integration features.
projects.longDescription: Developed a modern boardroom management application with real-time collaboration features. Implemented WebSocket connections for live updates, drag-and-drop functionality for task organization, and comprehensive team management capabilities.
highlights: Intuitive drag-and-drop interface for task organization
Advanced team management and role-based permissions
